title: Module
description: One lesson block (content/modules/<id>.json). A meeting is a sequence of modules. PLAN.md section 6.1. Leader-only fields (leaderScript, discussion answers, ifShortOnTime, lowVolunteerNote) never appear in the display window.

id.description: Must match the file name: opener-five-or-six.json has id "opener-five-or-six".

requirements.description: Badge requirements this module touches. Use [] for things like a closing prayer.

activityType.description: PLAN.md 7.2 lists competition, discussion, hands-on and outdoor. presentation, guest and devotional were added for the leader guide's opener, veteran Q&A and Armor of God blocks.

displayContent.description: What the boys see on the projector.

points.description: Short bullet points shown under the body. Boy-safe only: never answers.

promptLabel.description: What one prompt is called on screen, e.g. "Graduate" shows "Graduate 3 of 13". Defaults to "Question".

prompts.description: Numbered items shown one at a time on the projector, each with its own answer: graduates to sort, scenarios to judge. The → key steps through them before moving to the next module; R reveals the current one's answer. Added in Phase 1 (docs/decisions.md).

leaderScript.description: Step-by-step instructions for the leader, in order.

reveal.description: The answer key, shown on the projector only when the leader presses Reveal.

title.description: Optional heading above the answer key.

afterPrompt.description: Only for modules with prompts: where the answer key appears. 0 = right after the opening screen, 2 = after prompt 2. Leave it out to put the answer key after the last prompt. Without prompts, the answer key belongs to the opening screen.

table.description: For type "table". Each row names the fact that backs it, so every cell traces to a source.

factIds.description: Every fact this module states anywhere (display, script, answers). Used by the source check and by teach-back.
